name: lw_11359
statement: (a b c : ℝ) (habc : a * b * c = 1) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0) : (a + b) / (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 1)) + (b + c) / (Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 1)) + (c + a) / (Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + 1)) >= 3 * Real.sqrt 2
closed: ∀ (a b c : ℝ) (habc : a * b * c = 1) (ha : a > 0) (hb : b > 0) (hc : c > 0), (a + b) / (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + 1)) + (b + c) / (Real.sqrt (b ^ 2 + 1)) + (c + a) / (Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + 1)) >= 3 * Real.sqrt 2
informal: Let a,b,c>0 such that $abc = 1$ . Prove that \n $\frac{{a + b}}{{\sqrt {{a^2} + 1} }} + \frac{{b + c}}{{\sqrt {{b^2} + 1} }} + \frac{{c + a}}{{\sqrt {{c^2} + 1} }} \ge 3\sqrt 2 $ \n(NguyenNgocTu, July, 2018)
